lead: Friday opens with AI's infrastructure spreading in every direction: [Google unveiled Project Suncatcher](../summaries/a1a9cda1ffd3.md), a moonshot launching a prototype satellite to test whether its AI hardware survives orbit, while back on Earth [Docker released cloud sandboxes](../summaries/f29a87cc1c2f.md) so agents can run around the clock in their own microVMs, and [Gemini 3.8 Live's Live Avatar went generally available](../summaries/0c73632efa13.md) for enterprises. The money is moving too: [DensityAI, the chip startup founded by ex-Tesla Dojo leaders, is in talks to raise hundreds of millions at a $10B valuation](../summaries/b210ac1b4487.md). Governance kept pace: [Xi Jinping told a White House summit the US and China have 'the capability and responsibility to develop and manage AI for good'](../summaries/468aea7c71ac.md), [Massachusetts' gambling regulator will examine how DraftKings uses AI](../summaries/c99188b3ab8c.md), and [experts debated whether air-gapping AI](../summaries/d3308afa4bf8.md) could prevent another Hugging Face-style escape. And the code-breaking saga runs on: [researchers are still parsing the GPT-6 Astra logs](../summaries/a2d471e92c66.md) as new Bundesarchiv radio messages surface.
